content.title: Implement: fix regenerate route to forward auth context
content.description:
Fix the webapp regenerate route (packages/webapp/server/routes/users.ts:54) to forward the authenticated user's token using the new library API (usersRegenerate(name, { token }) or the agreed interface). Look up the target user's token and pass it so resolveAuthor resolves to the correct user instead of 'anonymous'.

ALSO update e2e/packages/webapp/e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts:197-216 to assert success (201 + new token) instead of 401 — the test currently locks the bug in as passing and MUST be flipped as part of the fix.
